needed.evidence: No footway provided, pedestrians must walk in the road
needed.suggestion: Install a continuous sidewalk along the left side of the road to provide safe walking space for pedestrians.

needed.evidence: Narrow and partly obstructed sidewalk due to parked vehicles or other obstacles
needed.suggestion: Remove obstructions and widen the narrow sidewalk on the right side to allow for safe pedestrian movement.

needed.evidence: Broken or uneven sections on the sidewalk that are trip hazards
needed.suggestion: Repair and resurface the uneven sections of the sidewalk on the right side to minimize tripping hazards.

needed.evidence: No purpose-built pedestrian crossing facility despite high crossing demand
needed.suggestion: Introduce a marked zebra crossing with refuge islands to provide a safer crossing facility for pedestrians.

needed.evidence: Current crossing is not easily visible or forced to be used due to poor marking
needed.suggestion: Upgrade the existing marked crossing to include raised platforms and enhanced signage to ensure it is easily visible and effectively reduces vehicle speeds.

needed.evidence: No dropped kerbs at the crossing, posing accessibility issues
needed.suggestion: Install kerb ramps at the crossing to facilitate accessibility for all pedestrians, including those with disabilities.

needed.evidence: Urban road lacks sufficient street lighting
needed.suggestion: Install ample street lighting along the road to improve visibility and safety, particularly during low light conditions.
